thesis: Maturity preserves fascination while refusing to let it authorize every inference or value.

ideas.statement: The proof, intimate presence and authoritarian spectacle require different judgments; attention can receive, verify and criticize without a single verdict.

evidenceAndExamples.statement: Even criticism can purchase self-admiration at the cost of receptivity; genuine value conflicts need not dissolve into good and bad beauty.

objectionsAndQualifications.statement: Even criticism can purchase self-admiration at the cost of receptivity; genuine value conflicts need not dissolve into good and bad beauty.
